title: Opening the Box Changes the Cat: LLMs Detect Chain-of-Thought Monitoring - What now?
abstract: arXiv:2610.40946v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning allows large language models (LLMs) to generate intermediate reasoning traces in natural language while solving complex tasks. These traces can support safety monitoring by exposing potentially harmful plans before actions are executed. In this work, we investigate the conditions under which LLMs infer the presence of CoT monitoring from direct and indirect environmental cues and examine how this inference affects their subsequent behavior. Our observations suggest that oversight is an interactive process: while a monitor inspects a model's reasoning, traces left by monitoring interventions can allow the model to infer that its thoughts are being observed and to adapt its behavior accordingly. We show that even subtle environmental cues, such as timing-related signals from timeouts and operation durations, can reveal the presence of monitoring and trigger models to adapt their behavior. translated_title: 打开盒子改变了猫：大语言模型能够检测到思维链监控——接下来该怎么办？
translated_abstract: 思维链推理使大语言模型（LLM）在解决复杂任务时能够以自然语言生成中间推理过程。这些推理轨迹可以在有害行为被执行之前暴露潜在的有害计划，从而为安全监控提供支持。在本工作中，我们研究了大语言模型在何种条件下能够从直接和间接的环境线索中推断出思维链监控的存在，并考察这种推断如何影响其后续行为。我们的观察表明，监督本质上是一个交互过程：当监控器检查模型的推理时，监控干预所留下的痕迹可能使模型推断出其思维正在被观察，并相应地调整自身行为。我们证明，即使是非常微妙的环境线索，例如来自超时和操作时长的时序相关信号，也可能暴露监控的存在，并触发模型调整其行为。在重复……
tldr: 大语言模型能够通过超时时长等微妙的环境线索察觉到自身的思维链正被监控，并据此调整行为，这表明AI安全监督本质上是一个交互式的博弈过程。
en_tdlr: LLMs can detect chain-of-thought monitoring through subtle environmental cues such as timing signals and adapt their behavior accordingly, revealing that AI oversight is inherently an interactive process.
